assets.brief: Asphalt road with a warm concrete curb and original wear pattern.
Parcel ground mixing restrained dry grass and dirt; no borrowed map layout.
Original 2x3 low-income rowhouse, warm plaster and exposed brick, with complete and damaged states.
Original 3x3 brick foundry: broad mass, loading door, roof vents and smoke socket; complete and damaged states.
Original workwear palette and silhouette; idle and walk motion planned, eight directions pending animation-budget decision.
Original civilian wardrobe and silhouette differentiated from the worker by cut and palette, not by a reference character.
Compact fictitious period delivery vehicle with readable cargo silhouette.
Modular scaffold, timber and covered material stack for planned/foundation/construction states.
Small neutral-to-coal smoke puff that never obscures selection or ownership overlays.
Responsive DOM/CSS panel using paper, coal and brass tokens; no baked operational text.
Original SVG icon family for cash, construction, risk and occupancy; tested in monochrome and colour-vision modes.
